name: Ralph Kenneth Allen
personality: An English scholar who could fluently speak Gaelic English and quote Steppenwolf at will
notable_stories: An English scholar who could fluently speak Gaelic English and quote Steppenwolf at will

The preparer, who knew him as 'Uncle' Ralph (actually his father's uncle), remembers being fascinated by him: he spoke old (Gaelic) English, could quote Steppenwolf at will, and had a sophisticated air.
milestones: Married Zella Campbell Whitman (m. 18 Aug 1928, Burton, WA)
career: Styled 'Prof.' and living in Portland, Oregon in 1953
English scholar (his daughter Judith also taught English)
sources: Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, compiled by William W. "Bill" Allen (2 April 2011 edition)
Family research emails, 2011–2013 (John and Barbara Adams with Irma Kulp Zacher, George F. Adams, Bill Allen and others)
notes: Ralph Allen researched the Adams family history, strongly supported the John Quincy Adams theory, and visited Beryl to share his findings. [Family research emails, email 41]

Open question: Were Eliza and Francis Hamilton children of Gavin Hamilton (Ralph Allen), grandchildren of Gavin Hamilton of Scotland via a Virginia line (George), or children of Francis and Susan Hamilton (Bill Allen)? [Family research emails, email 41]
Open question: Ralph Allen's claim of a Missouri land deed from JQ Adams to Jose has no documentation [Family research emails, email 41]
Open question: Bill Allen is described as Ralph Allen's nephew (email 41); in the tree William W. Allen is Ralph Kenneth Allen's grand-nephew. [Family research emails, email 41]
